messages:
lina_s (Sales): Sierra asks for a POC Tue: 400 sustained QPS, microbursts to 2k for <30s, p95<=250ms, SOC2 evidence. Can eng+solutions scope runbook + rough cost?

raj_e (Eng): Need region (they prefer us-west-2), avg tokens (they said ~160 in /120 out), Dedicated w/ VPC peering OK? streaming?

marta_solutions: Security wants CMK (HSM), VPC peering, audit logs. They prefer Dedicated for POC.

lina_s (Sales): Confirmed Dedicated + peering ok. Streaming on one path.

raj_e (Eng): Proposed short plan: warmup 5m@50, ramp 10m->500, sustain 30m@400, 3x 30s bursts@2k, cooldown 5m. Add 5m cold-cache run.

raj_e (Eng): Metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cache-hit%, GPU util, queue len, 429/5xx, sample traces.

raj_e (Eng): Non-stream script (vegeta) and separate streaming client.

kevin_oncall: Ops: enable Dedicated autoscale/burst. Fallback: shift 30% to rw-7b-quant if p95>500ms>2m. Alerts: p95>300 notify, errors>0.5% page.

marta_solutions: I'll draft security checklist for legal: CIDR, KMS ARN, SOC2, pentest window, audit-logs addendum.

lina_s (Sales): Pricing question: 2-week pilot estimate + monthly @400 QPS.

raj_e (Eng): Quick calc: ~280 tokens/req -> 112k tokens/s -> ~9.7B tokens/day -> ~135B tokens for 14d. Recommend scaled smoke at 10% + one full day run to extrapolate.

marta_solutions: Present Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved commit. Call out burst overage.

deploy-bot: Dedicated pool "sierra-dedicated-1" provisioning in us-west-2 (eta ~30m).

raj_e (Eng): Action items: I will provide scripts + dashboard by EOD tomorrow and run 10% smoke when pool ready.

lina_s (Sales): I'll collect CIDR, KMS ARN, sample payload and confirm scaled approach with Sierra. Cheers.
